summary: Full E2E retest after the multipart-field rename + warmup fix. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass against the live preview backend (health mode=external, warmup=200, analyze with field 'file' succeeds via Render, wrong field 'image' returns 422, text/plain returns 400 with 'unsupported'). Frontend: warmup GET /api/warmup fires automatically on Home mount (verified via network listener), upload+analyze against live Render analyzer completes ~15s returning score 70/100 with 2 markers + 2 finding cards, severity/category filters reduce visible cards correctly, multi-image upload works (2 thumbs, click switches active), About page shows the 3 team cards in order Illia -> Jonny -> Satyan with 'NGN Hackathon 2026' referenced.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: on external-analyzer exception the code silently falls back to mock while response.source is still returned - user cannot tell it was a fallback. Consider surfacing a fallback indicator or logging response detail.
server.py: MongoDB client is created but unused; either wire it or drop the import to avoid dead deps.
api.js: axios timeout 180s is fine, but there is no explicit retry after the automatic warmup - single retry on ECONNABORTED would improve UX on very cold starts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend already uses ANALYZER_URL=https://accesslens-hm23.onrender.com/analyze with ANALYZER_FIELD=file. Render was warm during this run. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_accesslens_api.py can be reused as regression. Frontend data-testids verified working: browse-file-input, analyze-btn, image-canvas, results-panel, score-value, marker-*, finding-card-*, filter-sev-*, filter-cat-*, thumb-*, nav-about, team-card-0/1/2.
